note: Bill's weekly queue (Empire HQ, riftcompare.com/admin/hq). One row per step that needs Bill's hands. PUBLIC FILE: a title, a reason and the project-files path of the prompt only; never a key, a token, an address or a private name. Add a row and commit to main (no deploy needed: HQ reads this file from GitHub). Set done to the day you verified it, or Bill presses Done on HQ. The prompt text itself stays in project files; each Monday the steps still open are joined into one Chrome batch, chrome-queue/<date>.md.

steps.title: Create the Compare Empire Bluesky account (one time; it then posts itself)
steps.why: The daily Bluesky job is built and dry-running: two link cards a day across all 13 sites, no recurring work, once the account exists.

steps.title: Turn off CamCompare's Vercel bot challenge again
steps.why: Since about 2 Nov it answers non-browser clients with 429 (fixed 30 Oct, back again): it blocks link previews, IndexNow and the Bluesky poster's CamCompare cards.

steps.title: Create the free Compare Empire GitHub organization (moves nothing)
steps.why: Step 1 of the approved consolidation plan: shared secrets and one place for every repo.

steps.title: Let the earnings dashboard read Vercel's cost per site
steps.why: Without it HQ and the Monday report show earnings per site but no cost, so no profit per site.

steps.title: Create Amazon tracking IDs for DexCompare, MTG Compare and OP Compare
steps.why: Their Amazon sales are counted under RiftCompare's tag today, so HQ cannot credit them per site.

steps.title: Finish Cyberpunk Compare's account setup (check first: eBay keys, Search Console)
steps.why: The site is live; eBay prices stay off until its own keys exist, and Google needs the property.

steps.title: Set up and list the Discord price bot (one time, about 45 minutes)
steps.why: Built in October (TCGEmpire #185); it answers price lookups in Discord servers once its keys exist.

steps.title: Create the RiftCompare Deals Telegram channel (one time)
steps.why: Built in October (TCGEmpire #189); the daily eBay deals post goes out once the bot token and channel exist.

steps.title: Join Amazon Associates UK, Canada and Germany, and set the new tags on every site
steps.why: UK, CA and EU visitors see no Amazon link today; every site's code is already wired for the tags.
